=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:628-634 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `capture_run_id` interpolates `${ISSUE_TITLE}` directly into the jq filter string, so a future title containing jq-special characters could break the query and return an empty run id.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers noted the shell-expanded jq string is fragile; the `--arg` pattern used elsewhere avoids parse failures.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:668
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The PLAN_RUN_STATUS jq query also interpolates `${ISSUE_TITLE}` directly, so a title with jq-special characters would make the query fail and fall back to "unknown."
  WHY: This is the same shell-to-jq fragility at a second query site; reviewers noted the safe `--arg` pattern is already used elsewhere.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:722-723 | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The OTHER_ACTIVE_PLAN_RUNS fetch uses bare `gh api` instead of the existing safe wrapper, so rate-limit failures collapse to the default empty run list.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this makes the poller treat an unknown API failure as "no active runs," which is fail-safe but can hide transient errors.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:881
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: IMPL_RUNS_JSON still uses per_page=50, so high workflow-run volume can truncate the relevant Implement run and stale the activity signal.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this can lead to a spurious inactivity timeout; the change to 100 was not applied here.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:618-634, 656-671, 706-735 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The later implement-phase `capture_run_id` call is not updated to the new `display_title` scoping, so a wrong Plan run ID can still be selected under high concurrency.
  WHY: The reviewer says the earlier polling sites were updated, but the later call still uses the older unfiltered behavior.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:391-403, 588-597 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The TITLE output is propagated as `ISSUE_TITLE`, but the surrounding comment and propagation make the fix look broader than it is; it only protects this smoke-test path.
  WHY: The reviewer flagged misleading comments and partial propagation that could mislead maintainers about the scope of the fix.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:615-628, 729-735 | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When the jq filter produces no match, capture_run_id and the active-runs check fall back to empty/0 without warning or fallback, so the test can proceed without a detected Plan run.
  WHY: The reviewer says this can trigger the later label-based failure path silently instead of surfacing the missing match.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:618-634, 656-671 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `ISSUE_TITLE`/`display_title` filter has no fallback for older GitHub API responses that omit `display_title` or for event types that don't set issue titles identically.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this could break backward compatibility with the previous global heuristic under older API behavior.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
